correctness.rationale: Explicit graph models and all 65536 masks per graph were independently checked; dual face vectors and all Hasse incidences were enumerated. Acyclic Morse reductions leave specified critical cells. Signed integral Morse differentials square to zero and admit complete unimodular unit-pivot eliminations (four and six unit ranks for Shrikhande, zero for rook), so all integer homology is free. Independent original mod-two boundary ranks agree. Integral Alexander duality shifts dimensions by 13-i and yields the claimed exact vectors. The proof asserts no broader or homotopy classification.

value.rationale: A canonical nonisomorphic cospectral strongly regular pair with identical (16,6,2,2) parameters has four-cut complexes with the same Euler characteristic but distinct complete integral homology. The extra degree-nine Shrikhande group detects topology below the top two degrees, and all non-top classes obstruct pure shellability. Cut size four and connected-quadruple constraints are natural from the foundational graph cut-complex literature; exact torsion-free classifications are not arbitrary slices.
